subject: Simple cfa with one ordinal variable. mplus = lavaan?

messages.author: c69bf3eeace29d5d
messages.subject: Simple cfa with one ordinal variable. mplus = lavaan?
parts:
Dear lavaan users.

I have a CFA with one ordinal variable. With lavaan I get nonconvergence, but with Mplus I get convergence.

My question is: Is not lavaan based on DWLS estimation in the same way that Mplus does by default? 

Code and results below: 

I am trying to estimate a model where one variable is ordinal (only roykeslutt)

cfa.model = "QUITTING =~ roykeslutt+ sigaretterprdagt2 
PBC =~PBC1+PBC2+PBC3
GC =~ inten1+plan1+plan2+plan3"

DWLS estimation does not converge: 

> f=cfa(cfa.model, data=TPBnytt, ordered=c("roykeslutt"))

On 10/03/2013 03:03 PM, Nj�l Foldnes wrote:

> *My question is: Is not lavaan based on DWLS estimation in the same way
> that Mplus does by default? *

Yes.

Perhaps this is a scaling problem:

> /9 QUITTING.BY SIGARETTER -8.088 0.606 -13.353 0.000/

Could you rescale SIGARETTER (sigaretterprdagt2 in lavaan) so that is
scale is more similar to roykeslutt. Or provide a starting value (say, -8.0)

Yves.
